newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Trading in Banespa remains suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Banespa remains suspended.

text.p: Trading in Sao Paulo state bank Banespa remained suspended on the local bolsas Monday despite the bank's published statement on a debt rescheduling deal, Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) said.
The CVM said it found Banespa's published statement insufficient and asked for further information.
Last week Sao Paulo state and the federal government finalized a major debt rescheduling deal under which a controlling stake in Banespa was transferred to federal hands.
Banespa stock has been out of the bolsas since last Wednesday.
